answer: Each dawn, every identity must present a fresh jade seal earned by completing one verified task in the previous epoch; the seal is bound to a velvet reputation ledger that records quality, not volume, so one honest agent keeps one seal with one day of work. An attacker running a thousand fakes must complete a thousand distinct verified tasks before every dawn, pay the full work cost a thousand times over, and any fake caught copying loses its seal and all accumulated reputation at once, so scaling sybils means paying honest cost per identity, every single day.
